new_content.name: Detached Creaking Heart
new_content.how_to_obtain: Strip a vanilla Creaking Heart with an axe.
new_content.notes: Decorative; links to no pale oak and spawns no creakings. Orientation of its glowing faces depends on placement.

new_content.name: Clipped Eyeblossom / Clipped Open Eyeblossom (and potted versions)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Use shears on a vanilla eyeblossom.
new_content.notes: Frozen open or closed; no longer cycles with time of day.

new_content.name: Pale Pumpkin, Pale Carved Pumpkin, Pale Jack o'Lantern, Pale Pumpkin Seeds, Pale Pumpkin Stem
new_content.how_to_obtain: Pale pumpkin patches grow naturally in Pale Garden biomes; seeds and jack o'lantern have crafting recipes.
new_content.notes: A carved pale pumpkin worn as a helmet stops creakings (tame or wild) from noticing you.

new_content.name: Creaking Golem
new_content.how_to_obtain: Build a golem shape from pale oak fence and logs around a Creaking Heart, topped with a carved pale pumpkin or jack o'lantern.
new_content.notes: Friendly and sturdy; freezes when stared at like a wild creaking but never attacks. Built around a Detached Creaking Heart it becomes an inert statue.

vanilla_changes.change: Shaped: Artificial Creaking Heart surrounded by 8 resin clumps -> creaking heart.
Shapeless: clipped eyeblossom -> gray dye; clipped open eyeblossom -> orange dye.

getting_started: Visit a Pale Garden: strip a creaking heart with an axe or shear an eyeblossom to get decorative versions.
editor_notes: Recipe inputs not extracted; check jar recipes before publishing a recipe table. Two advancements: Change of Heart (strip a heart) and a creaking golem summon advancement. A shaped creaking_heart recipe exists, possibly for the detached variant.
name: Artificial Heart
summary: Decorative, harmless versions of the Pale Garden's creaking heart and eyeblossoms, plus pale pumpkins and a friendly creaking golem. Made by the pack author.
